subject: general
question: What kind of resources are the fossil fuels coal and petroleum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Exhaustible and non-renewable**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fossil fuels like **coal and petroleum** are **e****xhaustible and non-renewable**.
 
• **Exhaustible**: Fossil fuels like coal and petroleum are **formed from the buried remains of dead organisms over millions of years**.
 
 
• This p**rocess is extremely slow** and **cannot be replicated within human timescales**.
 
• Therefore, these resources are finite and will eventually run out.
 
 
 
• **Non-renewable**: Unlike renewable resources like sunlight, wind, and water that are constantly replenished, **fossil fuels cannot be readily replaced once they are extracted and used**.
 
 
• Their formation takes millions of years, making them essentially non-renewable in practical terms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Renewable Energy sources**:

 
 
• These are those that **come from naturally occurring**, **self-replenishing sources**.
 
• They are becoming increasingly important as we look to move away from fossil fuels and reduce our impact on the environment.
 
• Here are some of the most common types of renewable energy sources :
 
 
• **Solar energy**, Wind energy, **Hydropower**, **Geothermal energy**, Biomass energy, **Ocean energy**, etc.
